Insight From E
Well one night a friend of mine called and told me he could get a blue dolphin triple stack, and from what I know about E that's one of the better.  So with a crazy night ahead I bought the pill.  I saved it for a day and took it at 10 p.m.  It didn't start kicking it until around 11 but the feelings that came were some that have changed my life forever.  Music was a driving force for me roll, and the many soothing sounds made me insides tingle.  I really have never had as much appreciation as I do for the talented people who make music and for the words they speak.  I love life, and could wish no harm on any living thing from this night on, haha I'm still rolling as we speak.
